fusions.name: Tongue-Tied
fusions.desc: Flicks a sticky strand that deals 5 damage and makes the target [Slowed], moving 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Startle Ring
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 14 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Springboard Knot
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sudden Spring
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
